method: Actual fixed-baseline/current production static exports, same25-record synthetic memory API. Three fresh browser contexts per condition, alternated before/after. Cache enabled, no Playwright interception; CDN icon source blocked equally. Desktop unthrottled; mobile390px CPU6x, latency150ms, down200000B/s, up93750B/s. First trial per condition records initial load plus entry navigation in trace. Local laboratory samples, not real-user vitals or deployed database latency. Asset bytes are actual decoded responses; gzip is calculated separately, server itself serves uncompressed. Guide-open timing includes Playwright scroll/click, navigation, fetch and first visible card.
